The summary says the documented method fails and they used an alternative. That alternative produced a site that works but is missing modules/config compared to the intended config set. This suggests the installation is not complete relative to the intended configuration—the interactive map/OSM feature is disabled.

Hmm, 1546 config differences is huge. It indicates the database config does not match the exported config. For a distribution, config/sync should match the installed state after install. This mismatch suggests the install used different defaults. But many could be legitimate (e.g., uuid, _core hashes, language translations).
